teaser.en: Its name means 'peel off', a warning about the burning white latex that can make skin blister and peel.
teaser.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'kuchubuka', onyo kuhusu utomvu mweupe unaounguza ambao unaweza kufanya ngozi itoke malengelenge na kuchubuka.
teaser.dg: Dzinare rina mana ya 'anduka' (*peel off*), ni onyo kuhusu maziya mereru ganayoocha, ganayoweza kuhenda ngozi ilavye marenje-renje na ianduke.

summary.en: *Chiyuyu* is a succulent bush shrub with fleshy leaves and a burning white latex. Its Digo name is a plain warning of what the sap does to skin.
summary.sw: *Chiyuyu* ni kichaka cha vichakani chenye utomvu mwingi, majani manene yenye majimaji na utomvu mweupe unaounguza. Jina lake la Kidigo ni onyo la wazi kuhusu kile ambacho utomvu huo huifanyia ngozi.
summary.dg: *Chiyuyu* ni chitsaka cha weruni chenye makodza maziho genye madzi na maziya mereru ganayoocha. Dzina ra Chidigo ni onyo ra wazi ra vira maziya higa ganavyohenda ngozi.

about.en: *Chiyuyu* is a succulent shrub in the euphorbia family, with thick, fleshy leaves and soft green stems. Break any part and a white, milky latex runs out. That latex is caustic: it burns the skin and can make it peel, so the plant is best handled with care, and kept well away from the eyes.
about.sw: *Chiyuyu* ni kichaka chenye majimaji cha familia ya mibono (jamii ya *Euphorbia*), chenye majani manene yenye majimaji na mashina laini ya kijani. Ukivunja sehemu yoyote, utomvu mweupe kama maziwa hutiririka. Utomvu huo ni mkali: huunguza ngozi na unaweza kuifanya ichubuke, kwa hiyo ni bora kuushika mmea huu kwa uangalifu, na kuuweka mbali kabisa na macho.
about.dg: *Chiyuyu* ni chitsaka chenye madzi manji ndani, cha jamii ya mwono, chenye makodza maziho genye madzi na makolo ga chijani ganayokala laini. Uchivundza seemu yoyosi, maziya mereru ganatuluka. Maziya higa ni makali: ganaocha ngozi na ganaweza kuhenda ianduke, kpwa hivyo ni bora kuugbwira mmea uhu kpwa makini, na kuuika kure na matso.

culture.en: The name *chiyuyu* means 'peel off', because the latex burns and makes the skin peel. The name works as a lesson in itself: anyone who learns it learns to leave the sap alone.
culture.sw: Jina *chiyuyu* lina maana ya 'kuchubuka', kwa sababu utomvu wake huunguza na kufanya ngozi ichubuke. Jina lenyewe ni somo: yeyote anayejifunza jina hili hujifunza kuuacha utomvu huo.
culture.dg: Dzina *chiyuyu* rina mana ya 'anduka' (*peel off*), kpwa sababu maziyage ganaocha na kuhenda ngozi ianduke. Dzina ra hiri ni fundzo ra macheye: yeyesi anayerimanya, anamanya kuricha maziya higa.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *chiyuyu* and *tupa*. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Synadenium pereskiifolium*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *chiyuyu* na *tupa*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanakiita *Synadenium pereskiifolium*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *chiyuyu* na *tupa*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anachiiha *Synadenium pereskiifolium*.

reason.en: Euphorbia, a succulent relative with milky latex
reason.sw: *Euphorbia*, jamaa mwenye majimaji na utomvu kama maziwa
reason.dg: *Ganga*, ndugu wa jamii mwenga, wenye madzi manji ndani na maziya mereru

reason.en: Castor oil plant, same spurge family
reason.sw: Mbarika, wa familia ileile ya mibono

reason.en: Arrow-poison tree, another plant known for its dangerous sap
reason.sw: Mti wa sumu ya mishale, mmea mwingine unaojulikana kwa utomvu wake hatari
reason.dg: *Utsungu*, mmea wanjina unaomanyikana kpwa maziyage ga hatari

reason.en: Sodom apple, another bush plant to handle with care
reason.sw: Mtunguja (*Sodom apple*), mmea mwingine wa vichakani wa kushika kwa uangalifu
reason.dg: *Mtungudza koma*, mmea wanjina wa weruni wa kugbwirwa kpwa makini

definition.en: A burning, itching latex that harms the skin and eyes, so people avoid it.
definition.sw: Utomvu unaounguza na kuwasha, unaodhuru ngozi na macho, kwa hiyo watu huuepuka.
definition.dg: Maziya ganayoocha na kuawiwa, ganayobananga ngozi na matso, kpwa hivyo atu nkugahepa.

use.en: Some people use it as a fish poison.
use.sw: Baadhi ya watu huutumia kama sumu ya kuvulia samaki.
use.dg: Atu anjina nkugahumira dza sumu ya kuolaga ng'onda.
